# The build backend the release workflow builds with (uv build
# --build-constraint), pinned with its dependencies so a rebuild of the same
# commit gives the same bytes. With these pins, a build of 6d89338ab
# reproduces PyPI's policyengine-uk 2.126.8 wheel and sdist byte for byte.
# A rebuild must match: if an upload stopped part way, "Re-run all jobs"
# rebuilds, and Publish refuses a file that differs from what PyPI has.
# Update these deliberately, in their own pull request.
